_doc: Town buildings of group towns2 (Slateport, Mauville, Verdanturf) in exterior pack 0 (patches/area2_buildings.py; format as data/buildings/slice.json), res range 340-359. Models are made by b2tools/models_slateport.py, models_mauville.py, models_verdanturf.py (notes/TOWNS_TOWNS2.md). Shared models placed but not made here: res 0 Pokemon Center, res 3 Mart (slice), res 320 Gym (towns1), res 362 Contest Hall (towns3). door 65535 = no door model. dx: door models 259-261 span x -17..1 around their origin, so dx = door tile centre - footprint centre + 8; door_pc (93) is centred (+0). Door dz: the door model's glass (door 165/236 at z 0, 164 at -1) and plate (+2) must stay 1 unit or more off the wall and frame planes they overlap (melonDS flicker); dz was moved forward where b2tools/exterior_check.py found them closer (exterior sweep 2026-10-06).
